name: librelink-mcp-server
description: FreeStyle Libre CGM data in Claude via LibreLinkUp: current glucose, history, statistics and trends, with credentials encrypted in the OS keychain.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitor through the LibreLinkUp API (v4.16.0).

Exposes 10 tools: current reading with trend arrow, historical readings, statistics (average, GMI, time in range, variability), pattern analysis (dawn phenomenon, meal responses, overnight stability), sensor status, and credential/session management.

Credentials are stored AES-256-GCM encrypted with the key kept in the OS keychain (Keytar) and a file fallback when Keytar is unavailable. All 13 LibreLinkUp regions are supported. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

tools.name: get_current_glucose
tools.description: Most recent glucose reading with trend direction and in-range flag.

tools.name: get_glucose_history
tools.description: Timestamped glucose readings for a period (default 24 hours).

tools.name: get_glucose_stats
tools.description: Average, GMI (estimated A1C), time in range and variability metrics.

tools.name: get_glucose_trends
tools.description: Recurring patterns: dawn phenomenon, meal responses, overnight stability.

tools.name: get_sensor_info
tools.description: Active sensor serial number, activation date and status.

tools.name: configure_credentials
tools.description: Store LibreLinkUp credentials, encrypted with the key in the OS keychain.

tools.name: configure_ranges
tools.description: Set the personal target glucose range used for time-in-range calculations.

tools.name: validate_connection
tools.description: Test the LibreLinkUp connection and the stored credentials.

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Authentication state, token validity and expiration.

tools.name: clear_session
tools.description: Drop the current session and stored tokens to force re-authentication.
